changelog:
Initial release of deep-token-saver: a comprehensive token-saving solution with 6-layer technology stack.

- Implements Caveman Mode and multi-layered (L0/L1/L2) input/output compression
- Supports memory deduplication, note abstraction, and AGENTS data compression
- Integrates persistent cross-session memory management via Remnic and QMD
- Adds automated and manual tools for memory consolidation and token-saving auditing
- Provides clear error handling and user maintenance commands
summary: 综合 token 节省方案。6层技术叠加，从输入/输出/记忆/上下文/审计全链路降本。含Caveman、L0/L1/L2分层、Remnic/QMD持久化、记忆去重、AGENTS压缩、Token审计。
